results.title: Majors escalate sync enforcement against unlicensed film use
excerpts: Universal Music Group has filed suit against several production companies over uncleared synchronisation of recordings, seeking statutory damages under 17 U.S.C. 504(c).

results.title: Universal Music Publishing Group — sync licensing
excerpts: UMPG administers the composition catalogue and processes synchronisation requests for film and television through its licensing desk.
